questions.q_en: Your three timing arms are one day apart. What can one day actually change in an Arabidopsis seedling, and what is that arm really asking?
questions.q_zh: 你們三個時機組只差一天。一天在阿拉伯芥幼苗身上實際能改變什麼？這一組真正在問的是什麼？
questions.a_en: Twenty-four hours changes gene expression and almost nothing else, so the timing arm is not asking whether the plant had time to grow. It asks whether the protectant has to arrive before the stress surge, and that decides whether the reactor, the forecast and the field sensors are worth building. Our heat data give it a mechanism: ethylene rises both when heat is applied and again when it is removed in recovery, so a one-day offset lands on a different hormonal moment. The answer is not settled. On agar at 75 mM pre-treatment gave the highest fresh weight, 0.164 against 0.144 grams, while in soil at 300 mM only post-treatment beat the control.
questions.a_zh: 二十四小時能改變基因表現，其他幾乎什麼都改變不了，所以這一組不是在問植物有沒有時間長大。它問的是保護劑是不是必須在逆境高峰之前就到，而這決定了反應器、預報和田間感測器值不值得做。我們的熱逆境數據還給了它一個機制：ethylene 在加熱時和熱移除、進入恢復期時各上升一次，所以差一天就落在不同的荷爾蒙時刻。但答案還沒定。瓊脂上 75 mM 時預先處理鮮重最高，0.164 對 0.144 公克；而土壤 300 mM 時只有事後處理贏過對照。
questions.trap_en: Reporting a best timing as settled, when agar favours pre-treatment and the soil run favours post-treatment.
questions.trap_zh: 把最佳施用時機講成已經確定，但瓊脂偏向預先處理、土壤那一輪偏向事後處理。
questions.basis: timing is the result the AIoT forecast is justified by

questions.q_en: Rescue and priming are not the same claim. Which one are you testing, and which one could your assay even detect?
questions.q_zh: 拯救和預先誘導（priming）是兩種不同的主張。你們測的是哪一種？而你們的實驗設計又真的能測出哪一種？
kw_zh: 預先處理就是 priming 組
questions.a_en: Rescue means the molecule does the work. Priming means the plant does it, faster, because it was warned. Dr. Verslues pushed us that way, to work with the plant's natural response rather than simply supply more proline, and toward early detection rather than recovery after damage. We use the word ourselves: pre-treatment is meant to prime the plant's defences before cellular damage, and our heat protocol is thermo-priming for acquired thermotolerance. The problem is that our assay cannot separate them. A primed plant is defined by how it answers a later stress, so you need a second challenge or a time course. We read one endpoint after one stress.
questions.a_zh: 拯救是分子自己把工作做完，priming 是植物自己做、只是因為事先被提醒過所以反應更快。Dr. Verslues 把我們往這個方向推，要我們配合植物自己的反應，而不是單純補更多 proline，也要我們做早期偵測而不是受害後的恢復。我們自己也在用這個詞：預先處理的目的就是在細胞受損之前先把防禦 prime 起來，而我們的熱逆境流程本身就是誘導耐熱性的 thermo-priming。問題是我們的設計分不開這兩者。一株被 prime 過的植物，定義在於它怎麼回應下一次逆境，所以需要第二次逆境或一條時間曲線，而我們只在一次逆境後讀一個終點。
questions.trap_en: Claiming a priming mechanism from a single-stress, single-endpoint experiment.
questions.trap_zh: 用單一逆境、單一終點的實驗去主張 priming 機制。
questions.basis: an advisor redirected the project from rescue to prevention

questions.q_en: ACC and the step that makes ethylene are inside the plant cell, and a cell wall will not pass a forty-kilodalton enzyme. So how is a sprayed ACC deaminase supposed to lower ethylene at all?
questions.q_zh: ACC 和製造 ethylene 的那一步都在植物細胞裡，而細胞壁不會讓一個四十幾 kDa 的酵素通過。那噴上去的 ACC deaminase 到底要怎麼降低 ethylene？
kw_zh: 我們的寫法講的是吸收
questions.a_en: It never has to get inside. The enzyme works as a sink outside the plant: it cleaves ACC in the root zone into ammonia and alpha-ketobutyrate, which lowers external ACC, and the gradient pulls more ACC out of the root as exudate, so less is left inside to become ethylene. Prof. Huang told us as much, that a protectant like ACC deaminase only needs to reach the root zone rather than enter the root directly. I should flag our own wording, though. Our heat section says we sprayed because the enzyme is large and poorly absorbed through roots, and that frames it as uptake when the mechanism is really an external sink.
questions.a_zh: 它根本不需要進去。這個酵素是在植物外面當一個消耗端：它在根圈把 ACC 切成氨和 alpha-ketobutyrate，使外部的 ACC 濃度下降，這個梯度就把更多 ACC 以根分泌物的形式拉出來，於是細胞內剩下能變成 ethylene 的就少了。黃老師也是這樣跟我們說的，像 ACC deaminase 這樣的保護劑只需要到根圈，不需要直接進到根裡面。不過我也要指出我們自己的寫法：熱逆境那一節寫我們改用噴灑是因為酵素比較大、不容易被根吸收，這個說法把它講成吸收問題，而機制其實是一個外部的消耗端。
questions.trap_en: Saying the enzyme enters the plant or acts on ethylene directly, instead of explaining the external ACC sink and the exudation gradient.
questions.trap_zh: 說酵素進到植物裡、或直接作用在 ethylene 上，而不是解釋根外的 ACC 消耗端與外排梯度。
questions.basis: the mechanism a plant postdoc will test first

questions.q_en: Distinguish the apoplastic ACC pool from the intracellular one. Which pool does your enzyme see, and what follows for how much of it you need to make?
questions.q_zh: 請區分細胞外質體（apoplast）的 ACC 池和細胞內的 ACC 池。你們的酵素看得到哪一個？由此推論你們到底需要生產多少酵素？
questions.a_en: The pool our enzyme can see is the external one, in the medium or the root zone. The intracellular pool, where ACC is made and then oxidised, sits behind a membrane the enzyme does not cross, and a leaf apoplast sits behind a cuticle; our own protein design page is careful that a docked model cannot say whether a peptide is taken up or even survives the apoplast. Two things follow. The plant's exudation rate sets a ceiling, so past some point more enzyme buys nothing and the useful lever is delivery to the root zone, not a bigger reactor. And our 37.6 kilounits per hectare is a scaled spray rate, not a measured requirement.
questions.a_zh: 我們的酵素看得到的是外部那個池，在培養基或根圈裡。細胞內那個池，也就是 ACC 被合成然後被氧化的地方，隔著一層酵素過不去的膜；而葉片的 apoplast 隔著角質層，我們自己的蛋白設計頁也很小心地說，對接模型沒辦法回答胜肽有沒有被吸收、甚至能不能在 apoplast 裡存活。由此推出兩件事。植物的外排速率就是天花板，超過那個點再多酵素也沒有用，真正有用的槓桿是把它送到根圈，而不是把反應器做大。另外，我們那個每公頃 37.6 千單位是由噴灑量換算出來的，不是量到的需求量。
questions.trap_en: Assuming more enzyme always means more effect, instead of recognising that export of ACC by the plant is rate-limiting.
questions.trap_zh: 以為酵素越多效果就越好，而沒看出限速的是植物把 ACC 排出去的速率。
questions.basis: the dose target the bioreactor is sized against

questions.q_en: ACC has signalling roles of its own, independent of ethylene. What does that do to your mechanism?
questions.q_zh: ACC 本身也有獨立於 ethylene 的訊息傳遞角色。這對你們的機制有什麼影響？
questions.a_en: It means draining ACC is not a neutral act. Our story is less ACC, less ethylene, longer roots, and that treats ACC purely as a precursor. Our own soil section is careful to say ethylene has important roles in normal development and that it is the excess which hurts. If ACC also signals in its own right, independently of ethylene perception, an enzyme that removes it could take away a wanted signal along with an unwanted one, and we would not see the difference, because our readouts are root length, fresh weight and chlorophyll. The test is to apply the enzyme to a line that cannot perceive ethylene. We have not run it.
questions.a_zh: 這表示把 ACC 抽掉並不是中性的動作。我們的說法是 ACC 少、ethylene 少、根就長，這等於把 ACC 純粹當成前驅物。我們自己的土壤那一節也很小心地寫，ethylene 在正常發育和逆境反應裡都有重要角色，有害的是過量。如果 ACC 本身也是訊息、而且不經過 ethylene 的感知，那麼把它移除的酵素可能同時拿掉需要的和不需要的訊息，而我們看不出差別，因為我們的讀值只有根長、鮮重和葉綠素。檢驗方法是把酵素用在無法感知 ethylene 的品系上，而這個實驗我們沒有做。
questions.trap_en: Treating ACC as nothing but an ethylene precursor, and so missing that the growth readouts cannot attribute the effect.
questions.trap_zh: 把 ACC 只當成 ethylene 的前驅物，因此沒意識到生長指標無法歸因效果來源。
questions.basis: attribution of the effect to ethylene is not established

questions.q_en: Under salt the plant has to manage its stomata and its sodium to potassium ratio. Which of those could your protectant touch, and which did you measure?
questions.q_zh: 鹽逆境下植物必須處理氣孔，也必須處理鈉鉀比。你們的保護劑可能影響哪一個？你們又量了哪一個？
questions.a_en: Plausibly the stomatal and senescence side, certainly not the ionic side. Lowering stress ethylene could slow leaf ageing and change how fast the plant shuts down, and chlorophyll retention is consistent with that. Sodium exclusion and holding potassium in the cell are transporter jobs, and an enzyme sitting in the root zone moves no ions. So the osmotic and signalling half of salt stress is in reach and the ionic half is not, which predicts that any effect of ours should look larger early and fade as sodium accumulates. The honest part is that we measured none of it. Our readouts are root length, fresh weight, chlorophyll and scored phenotype.
questions.a_zh: 有可能影響氣孔和老化這一側，離子那一側幾乎不可能。把逆境 ethylene 降下來，可以讓葉片老化變慢、讓植物關機的速度改變，而葉綠素被保留下來跟這個是一致的。但排鈉、把鉀留在細胞裡是運輸蛋白的工作，一個待在根圈的酵素搬不動任何離子。所以鹽逆境裡滲透和訊息那一半我們有機會碰到，離子那一半碰不到；這也預測我們若真有效果，應該早期比較明顯，隨著鈉累積而淡掉。老實的部分是，這些我們一個都沒量，我們的讀值只有根長、鮮重、葉綠素和表徵記錄。
questions.trap_en: Claiming the protectant improves salt tolerance generally, when nothing in the data addresses ion homeostasis.
questions.trap_zh: 籠統地說保護劑提升耐鹽性，但數據裡完全沒有任何離子平衡的證據。
questions.basis: half of salt stress is outside the proposed mechanism

questions.q_en: A thermo-priming treatment rewrites a transcriptome within hours. Your readouts are a weight and a pigment on day seventeen. What sits in that gap, and what does the far end look like for a farmer?
questions.q_zh: thermo-priming 在幾個小時內就把轉錄體改寫了，而你們的讀值是第十七天的重量和色素。中間那一段是什麼？而對農民來說，最後那一端又長什麼樣子？
kw_zh: 幾小時 vs 第十七天
questions.a_en: There is a time-scale gap in the middle of that run. Five days at thirty-seven degrees changes gene expression within hours, and we read fresh weight, root length and pigment on day seventeen after five days of recovery, with nothing in between. Prof. Cheng told us what belonged in the gap: visual ROS staining, as an early readout of oxidative damage. There is no ROS data anywhere in our work. So when pre-treatment retained the most chlorophyll under heat, about thirteen per cent of its non-stressed value, we cannot say the plant was less oxidatively stressed rather than greener at the end. And none of this is yield.
questions.a_zh: 那一輪實驗中間有一段時間尺度的空白。三十七度五天在幾小時內就改變基因表現，而我們是在五天恢復期之後、第十七天才讀鮮重、根長和色素，中間什麼都沒有。鄭老師告訴過我們那段空白該放什麼：目視的 ROS 染色，作為氧化傷害的早期讀值。而我們整個專案裡沒有任何 ROS 數據。所以當熱逆境下預先處理組保留了最多葉綠素、大約是它無逆境值的百分之十三時，我們沒辦法說那株植物真的氧化壓力比較低，而不只是最後比較綠。而這些都還不是產量。
questions.trap_en: Offering end-point chlorophyll as evidence of a priming mechanism, with no early biochemical readout between the two.
questions.trap_zh: 拿終點的葉綠素當 priming 機制的證據，中間完全沒有早期的生化讀值。
questions.basis: no measurement sits between the treatment and the phenotype

questions.q_en: BoPEP4 works through PEPR1-type receptor kinases, which switch on immunity. Would you expect that to cost the plant growth?
questions.q_zh: BoPEP4 是透過 PEPR1 這類受體激酶作用的，而那會啟動免疫反應。你們會預期這讓植物在生長上付出代價嗎？
questions.a_en: Yes, and our own hydroponic data point that way. BoPEP4 is an elicitor peptide from broccoli, read by the PEPR1 and PEPR2 receptor kinases with BAK1 as co-receptor, and the output is pattern-triggered immunity, which draws on the same resources as growth. With no stress applied, BoPEP4 from one in forty to one in a hundred gave slight anthocyanin accumulation while the culture and medium controls gave none, which we read as possible growth inhibition in an unstressed plant. Under 100 mM salt, one in forty was the only group where every plant stayed green, with the highest fresh weight and chlorophyll per plant. Narrow window, and one run.
questions.a_zh: 會，而我們自己的水耕數據也指向這個方向。BoPEP4 是來自青花菜的誘導胜肽，由 PEPR1 和 PEPR2 受體激酶讀取、以 BAK1 當共受體，而輸出是 pattern-triggered immunity，它和生長搶同樣的資源。在完全沒有加逆境的組裡，BoPEP4 從 1/40 到 1/100 都出現了輕微的花青素累積，而菌液對照和培養基對照都沒有，我們把這解讀為在無逆境植物上可能有生長抑制。而在 100 mM 鹽逆境下，1/40 是唯一所有植株都保持綠色的組，每株鮮重和葉綠素也最高。有效區間很窄，而且只做過一輪。
questions.trap_en: Presenting BoPEP4 as just a third protectant like the other two, and skipping the anthocyanin seen without any stress.
questions.trap_zh: 把 BoPEP4 講成和另外兩個一樣的第三種保護劑，又跳過無逆境時觀察到的花青素。
questions.basis: a defence elicitor is not a protectant in the same sense

questions.q_en: Exogenous spraying of plant protectants is already a commercial business. What exists on the market today, and what in your approach is actually new?
questions.q_zh: 外源噴施植物保護劑其實已經是一個商業領域了。市面上現在已經有什麼？你們的做法裡真正新的是什麼？
kw_zh: 我們的對照就是其中之一
questions.a_en: It exists and we used it. Our comparator was 富肽2號, a finished CH Biotech biostimulant applied at the supplier's one-in-five-hundred field dilution, which we did not change because a farmer would not. They never disclosed its active components, so we treat it as a product-level comparison, and they walked us through delivery by root irrigation, foliar spray and drone, regulatory requirements, and cost per unit area. So neither the molecule nor the spraying is new. What is new is making it on the farm in a contained reactor, which removes shelf life and transport, and releasing it on a forecast. Our model prices that at eighty-one litres of vessel per hectare.
questions.a_zh: 已經有了，而且我們還用了它。我們的對照是正瀚生技的成品生物刺激素「富肽2號」，依廠商建議的 1:500 田間稀釋使用，我們沒有改，因為農民也不會改。他們沒有揭露活性成分，所以我們把它當成產品層級的對照；他們也跟我們講了灌根、葉面噴施和無人機噴施這些施用方式，還有法規要求和每單位面積的成本。所以分子和噴施這件事都不新。新的是在農場上用密閉反應器現地生產，省掉保存期限和運輸，並依預報釋放。我們的模型把它估成每公頃八十一公升的槽體。
questions.trap_en: Claiming exogenous protectant spraying is novel, when the team's own comparator is a commercial product used at the supplier's dilution.
questions.trap_zh: 說外源噴施保護劑是新的，但自己的對照就是照廠商稀釋倍數使用的商品。
questions.basis: positioning against the product the team benchmarked against

questions.q_en: In soil at 300 mM, two of your three timings came out below the untreated control. Walk me through that.
questions.q_zh: 土壤 300 mM 那一輪，你們三個施用時機裡有兩個低於未處理對照。請跟我說清楚這件事。
questions.a_en: That is right, and I will give you the numbers. Without fresh-weight normalisation the extracts read about 1.00 milligrams per litre for the untreated control, 0.67 for pre-treatment, 0.30 for co-treatment and 1.13 for post-treatment. So only post-treatment beat the control, by about thirteen per cent, and the other two came out worse. That is the opposite ranking to our agar set 9, where pre-treatment was the best arm. One explanation we offer is the stress level: post-treatment went on a day after the first 300 mM dose, so it is a delayed co-treatment given once stress had developed. It is one preliminary pot series and it needs repeating.
questions.a_zh: 是的，而我直接把數字給你。在沒有以鮮重正規化的情況下，萃取液大約是未處理對照 1.00 毫克每公升、預先處理 0.67、同時處理 0.30、事後處理 1.13。所以只有事後處理贏過對照，大約多百分之十三，另外兩組反而更差。這和我們瓊脂 set 9 的排序相反，那裡預先處理是最好的一組。我們提出的一個解釋是逆境強度：事後處理是在第一次 300 mM 之後一天才施用，所以它其實是逆境已經發展出來後才給的延遲同時處理。這只是一輪初步的盆栽實驗，需要重做。
questions.trap_en: Quoting the plus thirteen per cent for post-treatment without saying pre- and co-treatment fell below the untreated control.
questions.trap_zh: 只引用事後處理多百分之十三，卻不說預先和同時處理其實低於未處理對照。
questions.basis: soil is the system closest to a field and it reverses the agar ranking

questions.q_en: Nothing in your project measures ethylene. What is the longest chain you can actually defend, and where exactly does it break?
questions.q_zh: 你們整個專案都沒有量到 ethylene。你真正能站得住的推論鏈最長到哪裡？又是在哪一環斷掉的？
questions.a_en: We have never measured ethylene, or ACC, in a plant, and there is no gas chromatography anywhere in our work. What I can defend runs like this. The literature says stress raises ethylene and that ethylene shortens roots and impairs photosynthesis, and that ACC deaminase cleaves ACC. Our own DNPH assay reads the alpha-ketobutyrate product, and gave 7.25 milliunits per millilitre from the permeate on the seventh of October, a single sample below the quantitation limit. Reading the same sample over twenty-eight hours instead gives 0.33, twenty-two-fold apart. So we cannot yet say how much active enzyme was in what we sprayed, let alone that plant ethylene fell.
questions.a_zh: 我們從來沒有在植物身上量過 ethylene，也沒有量過 ACC，而我們整個專案裡也沒有任何氣相層析。我能站得住的推論是這樣：文獻說逆境會讓 ethylene 上升，而 ethylene 會讓根變短、損害光合作用，也說 ACC deaminase 會切 ACC。我們自己的 DNPH 分析讀的是產物 alpha-ketobutyrate，十月七日從透過液讀到 7.25 毫單位每毫升，只有一個樣品，而且低於定量下限。同一個樣品改以二十八小時反應讀，得到 0.33，兩者差了二十二倍。所以我們還沒辦法說噴出去的東西裡有多少活性酵素，更不用說植物體內的 ethylene 下降了。
questions.trap_en: Offering the DNPH number as evidence that plant ethylene fell, when it measures a reaction product in a tube and sits below quantitation.
questions.trap_zh: 拿 DNPH 的數字當作植物體內 ethylene 下降的證據，但它量的是試管裡的反應產物，而且低於定量下限。
questions.basis: the project's central mechanism has no in-plant measurement
